title: e5a bs.1770 loudness meter and true peak

commit.merge_subject: merge: e5a bs.1770 loudness meter and true peak

description:
The E5-A loudness port (e4c18fc) compiles Loudness.cpp with
-ffp-contract=off in the desktop script (tools/build-desktop.sh, the
Yuv.cpp precedent), but the NDK/device build compiles the file
through core/CMakeLists.txt, which had no matching
set_source_files_properties entry - so a device build could contract
multiplies into FMAs and drift off the port's pinned test numbers
(test_loudness asserts 1e-8 nearness to the BS.1770-4 coefficient
table and bit-equality across feeding patterns; on arm64 clang
contracts by default at -O2).

This adds Loudness.cpp to the same -ffp-contract=off opt-out
Yuv.cpp and ImageStabPlan.cpp already have, so every target
(desktop, NDK, device) rounds the meter's arithmetic the same way.

Verified: desktop suite unchanged (27 doctest suites, 421 cases,
0 failed); :app:assembleDebug green with the NDK build re-running
configure + compiling src/Loudness.cpp.o f
changed: feat: port bs.1770 loudness meter and true peak
fix: apply ffp-contract off to loudness on ndk
